question: Can the cached Qwen3-8B model meet the full-information capability gate when only 20 transformer layers are offloaded to the GPU, keeping GPU utilization below the v0.7 stop condition while preserving the same model, prompts, sampler, task, and seed?
motivation: The v0.7 screen completed one long response quickly but saturated GPU utilization at 97% and 95%, triggering its automatic stop. The host CPU remained near 20%. This revision changes only GPU layer placement from 99 to 20 to test a lower-GPU-load operating point; CPU overload remains an automatic stop condition.

model.name: Qwen3-8B-Q4_K_M
model.runtime: llama.cpp b11202; RTX 4060 Laptop GPU 8 GB; 20 GPU layers; one slot; 8192 context
model.cpu_resource_limit: 4 generation threads and 4 prompt/batch threads; BelowNormal process priority

design.retry_policy: Use pinned HiddenBench ModelClient defaults; count server launches and completions separately. Any incomplete vote makes the screen incomplete; do not silently substitute another seed or task.
design.raw_outputs: Ignored local .cache only; never publish prompts, assignments, rationales, or raw vote records.

primary_outcome: Official HiddenBench initial individual-vote accuracy on the four-agent full-information task.
eligibility_gate: Pass only at 4/4 correct votes. If passed, a separately preregistered hidden-profile protocol study may use this model/configuration. If not, stop this model/task line; do not rank protocols.

resource_safeguards.launch_gate: Three host CPU samples averaged below 35% and NVIDIA GPU utilization below 60% before model load.
resource_safeguards.automatic_stop: Stop the runner and model service after host CPU is at least 75% for three consecutive 15-second samples, or GPU utilization is at least 90% for two consecutive samples.
resource_safeguards.telemetry: Record host CPU, server CPU cores, process working set, GPU utilization, and GPU memory every 15 seconds.
resource_safeguards.cleanup: The orchestrator terminates the model process in a finally block after success, failure, or interrupt.

limits: One task, one seed, and four votes are only an operating-point screen.
A pass does not demonstrate message benefit or protocol superiority.
A Qwen3-8B versus Qwen3-14B difference cannot be attributed to scale alone because checkpoint, quantization, runtime placement, and other settings differ.
This v0.8 placement is chosen after observing the v0.7 automatic resource stop and must be treated as a new configuration.
If the resource gate rejects launch, no server is started and no experiment result is recorded.
